recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-17489 unless the work group later revises the _filter grammar more broadly.
issue_request: FHIR-17489 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core search change request asking that the _filter formal grammar allow paramName to start with "_", enabling search parameters such as _id in _filter expressions. The resolution was Fix.
initial_application: The Jira comment records SVN revision 14561. The imported git commit 7d68ca3dc290f79411b2a2e5ce0dce3c4689fef1, titled "GF#17489 - allow filter parameter names to start with _", changed source/search_filter.html from an ALPHA-only paramName start rule to a nameCharStart rule allowing either "_" or ALPHA.
additional_context: source/search_filter.html is in current build scope via source/hierarchy.xml under the RESTful API pages. Later edits changed nearby _filter productions but preserved the underscore-permitting nameCharStart rule. Jira/community searches found no related or later decision that changes this conclusion; a Zulip infrastructure thread only confirms GF#17489 was considered for prompt processing in August 2018.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the current source already satisfies FHIR-17489 and no parallel source location retains the old ALPHA-only paramName grammar.
